generator: NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence([world_seed,epoch]); lexical public POI order; independent uniform draws < p; same draws across probability sensitivity
server_truth: Global availability for each POI is constant within each epoch, independent of target mobility; seeds and snapshots are evaluator/server inputs, not supplied to client planner
public_context: Original 419 POIs, directed road map, public catalogue and stable ties, common fixed query clocks
client_context: Static map and POI coordinates; only responses already received reveal current availability
controls: whole catalogue availability cached at epoch zero
full current availability bitmap every visited epoch (alternative bulk API)
response_memory_modes: union of responses within current availability epoch
metrics: Unchanged macro nonempty-category Recall@5 of current available nearest POIs; empty references counted separately; nested event->record->family/case means; report all 15 cases and 90% case-mean gate
cost: Coordinates and response ID slots per event; actual compact JSON bytes; bulk bitmap ceil(419/8) bytes plus separately stated epoch/header; availability simulation is not a network latency benchmark
privacy: No regenerated coordinates; same source attacks apply conditional on independent server status and fixed public clock. Client cache/rerank never changes requests. Bulk/fixed controls GPS independent conditional on clock/region. No new metadata guarantee.
independence: Three availability worlds are sensitivity replicates on reused development trajectories, not new users or independent confirmation
freeze_policy: Do not choose seed, probability, epoch or thresholds from observed scores; output every frozen variant; immutable result and input hashes
availability_clock: Public session-relative replay clock, starting at 0; the same synthetic snapshot sequence is replayed for each journey and shared across methods. These are separate replays, not one simultaneous city simulation.
